title: Gzifa the Pure One
summary: Gather the four spirits and follow their essences to reveal Gzifa.
overview: Gather the four spirits and follow their essences to reveal Gzifa.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep the remains together and allow the traveling essences to complete their route.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: One character must carry all four required remains into the trigger area; the items cannot be divided between players.
Defeat Talakoi, Ngozi, Mabiki and Yogundi so their ghostly essences can travel to the crystal room.
Once all four essences arrive, Gzifa spawns after a ten-second delay.

notes: Approval E294. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The trigger comment mentions a progression flag, but the current active condition checks the carried remains only.
